products.name: Govee LED Strip Light M1 (H61E0 6.56ft / H61E1 16.4ft)
products.query: Govee LED Strip Light M1 Matter
products.summary: A plug-in RGBIC strip with an adhesive back and a control box. Govee's Matter FAQ lists the M1 strip as its Matter-enabled strip, so it pairs with Apple Home by scanning the Matter QR code, with no bridge. Matter runs over Wi-Fi and shares on/off, brightness, color temperature and color with Apple Home; scenes, music sync and segment control stay in the Govee Home app.
products.renterNote: For a renter who wants a bedroom or TV-wall strip that Siri and the Home app can control without a bridge or hardwiring. Caveats: Apple Home needs a home hub (Apple TV or HomePod) for remote access and automations, Matter setup must be finished within 15 minutes of power-on and needs IPv6 and 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, and changing the Wi-Fi network from the Govee app turns Matter off. Older Govee strips without Matter need a bridge; check the Matter logo and the M1 model number before buying.
pros: Pairs with Apple Home over Matter with the QR code on the power cord or in the Govee app, no bridge needed (Govee Matter FAQ)
Adhesive-backed strip and control box plus a plug-in adapter, so no wiring or drilling
Matter multi-admin lets the same strip also be shared to Alexa or Google Home
cons: Only on/off, brightness, color temperature and color reach Apple Home; music sync, DIY effects and segment control stay in the Govee app
Matter over Wi-Fi only (no Thread), and the Matter link can drop if the Wi-Fi network is changed in the Govee app
Adhesive strip can't be cut shorter than 3 meters per Govee, so excess length must be coiled or doubled back

specs.matter: Yes, Matter over Wi-Fi; Govee's Matter FAQ lists M1 (2m) and M1 (5m, which requires a Matter-enabled control box) as the Matter-enabled strip
specs.homekit: Added to Apple Home through Matter; no native HomeKit certification claim found
specs.install: Adhesive back on the strip and the control box; plug-in power adapter
specs.leds: 60 LEDs per meter, RGBIC with white lighting
specs.expandable: 6.56ft strip can be spliced up to 16.4ft; 16.4ft strip up to 32.8ft (Govee refurbished-listing page)

products.scoreNote: Peel-and-stick plus plug-in power with no wiring; adhesive can still pull paint on removal. Matter gives bridge-free Apple Home control but only the basic light controls.
